toegepas.voor: was die Kasteel harde werk wat hulle nie kon weier nie
toegepas.na: het die Kasteel harde werk beteken wat hulle nie kon weier nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: A building cannot itself 'be' hard work; 'beteken' says what it meant to them and matches the block's closing sentence.
toegepas.fout: Loose copula: the building itself 'was' hard work, where the block means what it meant to the slaves.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Het ... harde werk beteken' says the same thing more exactly and supports the block's closing point that one building meant different things to different people, without touching any protected word.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Soos' in the sense of English 'as' (while, gradually) is an anglicism; 'namate' is the Afrikaans conjunction for a gradual change.
toegepas.fout: 'Soos' copies English 'as' in the sense of a gradual parallel change.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Namate' is the Afrikaans conjunction for this proportional-temporal link and keeps the meaning exactly.

laat_vaar.na: Vir 'n lang tyd het die museums
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A bare 'Lank' at the start of the sentence reads abruptly; 'Vir 'n lang tyd' is more natural and clearer for Grade 5.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Fronted 'Lank het ...' is natural Afrikaans, and 'Vir 'n lang tyd' leans towards English 'for a long time' while adding words.
